definitions.heldOutUse: neighbor interpolation followed by layer-3 development evaluation only; no held-out values are fitted into calibration
definitions.partialSelection: contiguous partial numbers 1..32 while below 18 kHz, capped by the 112-slot schema; direct strong modes take priority
definitions.velocityAnchorCaveat: The source inventory does not publish numeric MIDI velocities; 40/127, 80/127, and 120/127 are effective regression anchors, not claimed recording metadata.
definitions.perPartialGeneration: frozen algorithm-3 data loaded by digest; no string, decay, or secondary fitting was run
definitions.frozenInputs: algorithm-3 modal data and algorithm-4 register velocity parameters; neither was refitted

methods.frequency: layer-3 Hann/DFT fundamental and robust stiff-string-guided spectral peaks through partial 32; every emitted mode stores its direct effective frequency when measured
methods.decay: independent zero-phase bandpass/Hilbert T60 per measured partial; no base-decay conversion for accepted modes
methods.decayRejection: reject boundary fits, SNR<18 dB, drop<12 dB, residual>5 dB RMS, non-decay slopes, nonphysical T60, and T60>4*observed fit duration; rejected estimates are not calibration measurements
methods.legacyDecay: old per-key field is explicitly fallback-only for release/sympathy; direct fundamental T60, conservative shortest low-partial T60, octave median, or flagged analytic fallback
methods.secondary: at most three strong low/mid modes per fitting key; complex demodulated early fits with linear amplitudes; one/two components compared on a later untouched envelope; layers 1,3,4 must agree in direction and rough parameters
methods.secondaryGain: layer-3 fitted secondary/primary complex amplitude ratio; accepted only in 0.02..0.65 with no global aftersound multiplier
methods.heldOutSecondary: interpolate only modes accepted on both neighboring fitting keys with consistent direction; layer-3 amplitude-only early evaluation and later score do not change acceptance
methods.loudness: conservative layer-3 sustained stereo RMS, adjacent-fitting-key smoothing, square-root shrinkage, clamped to 0.6..1.6
methods.velocityGain: register-wise robust soft-L1 regression of early/sustained log RMS ratios at layers 1 and 4 relative to layer 3; six-observation ridge toward exponent 1
methods.velocityBrightness: independent register-wise robust regression of log high/low-band energy ratios; separate from gain, six-observation ridge toward 0
methods.excitationBands: low=0.5..2 times frozen fundamental, high=2..8 times frozen fundamental capped at 18 kHz; early stereo power after attack
methods.brightnessFallback: neutral exponent 0 and scale 1 when coverage, direction, residual, or boundary checks fail
methods.hammerStiffnessScale: register-relative effective brightness correction, not a mechanical hammer identification; middle=1, other registers use a shrunk log-brightness difference
methods.runtimeSemantics: gain and stiffness velocity factors are normalized at 80/127; existing nonlinear contact and hammer velocity laws are unchanged
methods.bodyResidual: dry-render/reference early and sustained RMS and log body-mode-band residuals; robust regional gain/tilt candidate with cross-key, cross-window, and cross-layer acceptance checks
methods.bodyFallback: neutral direct=1, resonance=1, tilt=0 unless the bounded candidate improves at least 65% of fitting observations and both windows/all layers without boundary solutions
methods.stereo: sustained L/R RMS balance relative to existing constant-power pan; layer median, within-register Gaussian smoothing, 0.35 shrinkage, and geometric-mean-preserving left/right corrections
methods.stereoScope: effective balance only; not physical key positions, phase, microphone response, or stereo correlation

bass.scaleMethod: middle register=1; otherwise exp(0.25*register reference-brightness difference), bounded; neutral when unreliable

middle.scaleMethod: middle register=1; otherwise exp(0.25*register reference-brightness difference), bounded; neutral when unreliable

treble.scaleMethod: middle register=1; otherwise exp(0.25*register reference-brightness difference), bounded; neutral when unreliable

bass.smoothing: Gaussian over fitting keys within two semitones inside each register; median across layers 1,3,4

middle.smoothing: Gaussian over fitting keys within two semitones inside each register; median across layers 1,3,4

treble.smoothing: Gaussian over fitting keys within two semitones inside each register; median across layers 1,3,4

excitationDevelopmentMetrics.levelAndBrightnessRatioReference: layer 3 at effective velocity 80/127; ratio metrics therefore exclude trivial layer-3 zeros
excitationDevelopmentMetrics.absoluteBrightnessModel: fitting-register layer-3 median + 4*log(hammerStiffnessScale) + velocity ratio exponent

protocol.velocityAnchorBasis: 60/127 follows the already documented 40/127,80/127,120/127 effective-anchor spacing; it is not fitted metadata
protocol.frequencyReference: layer-2 Hann/DFT fundamental and local spectral peaks; only frozen direct or neighbor-supported partials
protocol.decayReference: frozen strict bandpass/Hilbert T60 criteria; boundary and T60>4*fit-duration references rejected, never clamped
protocol.levelAndBrightness: actual body=1 renders; early RMS and independent log high/low-band power ratios using frozen fundamentals
protocol.stereo: actual body=1 rendered sustained L/R RMS balance including frozen stereo corrections
protocol.bodyResidual: neutral-body dry-render early+sustained level and existing body-mode-band residuals; no fitting

limitations: Earlier layer-2 exposure means this single frozen check belongs to the project development history and is not a pristine external test.
The numeric layer-2 velocity is an effective anchor, not published recording metadata; absolute level errors include corpus/renderer gain-scale differences.
Frequency and decay metrics include only supported reference measurements; rejected or extrapolated decays are counted, not silently accepted.
Brightness, stereo, and body residuals are effective recording/render comparisons, not identifications of physical hammer, microphone, soundboard, or room behavior.
No model parameter, threshold, fallback, interpolation, or secondary acceptance was changed by this evaluation.
Validation renders are derived local artifacts; no raw layer-2 audio is bundled.
Body parameters are effective residual radiation corrections, not identified soundboard geometry, material, poles, or damping.
Dry residual similarity is limited by frozen string and recording differences; unsupported fits remain neutral rather than extrapolating to note-specific noise or room tails.
Stereo gains are conservative sustained balance corrections and do not recover physical positions, phase, microphone response, or correlation.
Every-third-key body and stereo development uses layers 1, 3, and 4 only; final layer-2 validation remains pending and unread.
Analysis renders are derived local artifacts only; no raw recordings are bundled.
